sanskrit_verse:
समुत्थानव्ययं दाप्यः कलहाय कृतं च यत् ।
येनाङ्गेन द्विजातीनां शूद्रः प्रहरते रुषा ।
छेत्तव्यं तद् भवेत् तस्य मनुना समुदाहृतम् ॥
transliteration: samutthānavyayaṃ dāpyaḥ kalahāya kṛtaṃ ca yat / yenāṅgena dvijātīnāṃ śūdraḥ praharate ruṣā / chettavyaṃ tad bhavet tasya manunā samudāhṛtam //
sph_interpretive_translation: He who causes loss at the outset and creates conflict thereafter, and he who strikes a twice-born with rage using any limb—his corresponding limb shall be severed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious capacity, not birth alone
Causation is established through sequential intent and action
Restoration occurs through direct reversal of harm-causing mechanism
Consciousness alignment requires immediate cessation of harmful instrument
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A causes initial destabilization AND subsequent escalation THEN impose restorative liability proportional to initiation
IF agent B strikes a twice-born in anger THEN disable the specific limb used for aggression via surgical completion protocol
IF causal chain includes both material and energetic disruption THEN apply dual remediation: physical disablement + consciousness realignment session
IF perpetrator demonstrates continued aggressive capacity THEN initiate mandatory integrity-reintegration process before re-entry
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates based on threshold of conscious causation rather than mere physical act. The court determines whether the accused initiated destabilizing sequence AND employed sacred-violating force. Authority lies not in punitive sentencing but in executing precise restorative axioms that dismantle the instrument of violation while restoring victim's energetic field.

Anupūrvaśaḥ shows instrument-specific manifestation requiring instrument-specific reversal. Responsibility aligns proportionally to conscious choice exercised during escalation phase. Non-punitive reality rule mandates removal of harmful capacity without inflicting suffering; severance serves completion, not vengeance.

Mandatory participation in consciousness purification rituals until vibrational stability restored
Victim compensation through energy-field restoration procedures
Community witnessing of corrective action to reset collective dharma-field
Perpetrator undergoes limb-disabling ceremony followed by capacity-realization samskara
